hotel_1star_semantic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Seoul? Hotel Prices for Seoul, South Korea | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_semantic.evidenceText: On the exact-city page, BudgetYourTrip reports an average price of $55 for 1-star hotels based on 383 hotels, with a median of $42. The page describes one-night hotel-price ranges and states that prices are in US Dollars before taxes and fees, but it does not explicitly state two-person or two-adult occupancy.
hotel_1star_semantic.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled today; page states values change with seasons and are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_semantic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Seoul South Korea 1-star hotel average price room for two taxes fees
hotel_1star_semantic.reason: Exact city/class, statistic, unit context, currency, and tax basis were found, but explicit two-person occupancy is absent. Source-default or unspecified occupancy fails this semantic experiment.
